items.name: Gate Core
items.blurb: The heart of a dead gate, still warm, still humming a note you can only hear when you stop trying. It will restart a gate, if the gate will have it.

items.name: Hollow Kettle
items.blurb: It never boils over, and it is warm in your hands when nobody has lit anything. Its handle is a little too eager to be held. The Hollow take it as a sign that you have been to dinner.
